SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
FURTHER REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
S. D) 2554/11
Date August 29/1932
Subject (in full) Meeting of workers of Japanese industrial concerns.
Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]
About 11.30 a.m. August 28 some twenty male and female
workers of various Japanese industrial concerns in the Western
District assembled on a piece of waste ground off Kilochow
Road near Pinnay Road and proceeded in isolated groups to the
Jessfield Park where a meeting of twenty six labour representatives
of various Japanese industrial concerns was held. Siao Li
(小李), a representative of Mutual Aid Society, a communist
organ, presided over the function. The attendance after
discussing the proposed suspension of operations by Japanese
industrial concerns from September 8, passed the following
resolutions :-
1) That workers in the employ of Japanese industrial concerns.,
after having received their wages for the month of August,
declare a general strike on September 1.
2) That the representatives present at the meeting convene
'flying' meetings in their respective work-rooms on
August 29 and to explain to the workers details of the
proposed strike.
3) That workers of various industrial concerns engaged in
communist activities make arrangements to secure 50 male
and female juvenile workers from each of their respective
factories to participate in the celebration of the
Anniversary of International Youth Movement Day (September 4)
(venue to be decided later).
The meeting terminated at 3.30 p.m.
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

补充报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
档案编号
S. D) 2554/11
日期 1932年8月29日
主题（全称）日本工业企业工人会议。
呈报人 特别科督察 顾宝华 转呈 [签名]
8月28日上午11时30分左右，西区各日本工业企业的约二十名男女工人在靠近毕乃路（Pinnay Road）的胶州路（Kilochow Road）旁的一块空地上集合，随后分成若干小组前往兆丰公园（Jessfield Park），在那里举行了由各日本工业企业二十六名劳工代表参加的会议。共产主义组织“互济会”的代表小李（Siao Li）主持了此次活动。与会者在讨论了拟于9月8日起停止日本工业企业运营的提议后，通过了以下决议：-
1) 受雇于日本工业企业的工人，在领取8月份工资后，于9月1日宣布举行总罢工。
2) 出席会议的代表于8月29日在各车间召开“飞行”集会，向工人解释拟议罢工的细节。
3) 从事共产主义活动的各工业企业工人，须安排从各自工厂中确保五十名男女青年工人参加国际青年运动日周年纪念活动（9月4日）（地点待定）。
会议于下午3时30分结束。
顾宝华
特别科督察
特别科主管警官。
（批注：被日本人力车夫协会拒绝 8月29日）
（批注：收录于1932年8月29日情报报告）
（印章：E.H.R.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.: REGISTRY
S.2. N. D. 2554/11
Status 29 / 8 / 32
Date August to 10/32.

Subject (in full) Meeting of Unemployed Workers of Japanese industrial concerns.

Made by D.I.Kuli Pao-hwa Forwarded by （签名）

Between 9.30 and 10.30 a.m. August 27 eighteen
representatives of unemployed workers of Japanese industrial
concerns held a meeting in a dwelling house off Chur San Road,
Chpei, under the chairmanship of one Siao Woo (小何), a
representative of the branch of the local Chinese Communist
Party. During the course of the proceedings, the following
resolutions were passed :-

1) That an "Unemployed Workers Group" be organized.
2) That certain members be elected to supervise the activities
of the following places :
Woo Cha Zung (何家顺), N.W.K.No.3 Cotton Mill.
Kyung Sz Yoong(金比芳), N.W.K. No.4 Cotton Mill.
Woo Yoong Ping(何永聘), Special (Western) District.
3) That meetings be held at 9 a.m. every Saturday (venues to be
decided later).
4) That a preparatory meeting be held off Kiaochow Road near
Penang Road at 11.30 a.m. August 28 to discuss plans for
the celebration of the Anniversary of the International
Youth Movement Day which falls on September 4.

Kuli Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号：登记处
S.2. N. D. 2554/11
状态 1932年8月29日
日期 1932年8月至10月。

主题（全称）日本工业企业失业工人会议。

呈报人 特别科督察 顾宝华 转呈 （签名）

8月27日上午9时30分至10时30分之间，十八名日本工业企业失业工人代表在闸北（Chpei）楚山路（Chur San Road）旁的一处住宅内举行会议，由当地中国共产党支部代表小何（Siao Woo）担任主席。在会议过程中，通过了以下决议：-

1) 组建“失业工人小组”。
2) 选举某些成员监督以下地点的活动：
何家顺（Woo Cha Zung），西北纺织第三棉纺厂。
金比芳（Kyung Sz Yoong），西北纺织第四棉纺厂。
何永聘（Woo Yoong Ping），特别（西）区。
3) 每周六上午9时举行会议（地点待定）。
4) 于8月28日上午11时30分在靠近槟榔路（Penang Road）的胶州路（Kiaochow Road）旁举行预备会议，讨论庆祝9月4日国际青年运动日周年纪念活动的计划。

顾宝华
特别科督察

特别科主管警官。
